title: Acme Bike Repair, workshop for commuter bikes
h1: Bike repair with the price told first
description: Fixed-price bike repairs in two working days from a three-person workshop.
text: Acme fixes chains, brakes, gears and tyres. We tell you the price before we start. Bring your bike in or book a slot online.

title: Basic bike service
description: An hour-long check of brakes, gears and tyre pressure at a fixed price.
text: The basic service covers brakes, gears, chain wear and a check of every safety bolt. It takes about an hour.

title: Electric bike service and checks
description: Service for e-bikes with a standard drive unit.
text: We check the battery contacts and read the error log when the drive unit keeps one. We do not open sealed motors.

title: How to fix a flat tyre in ten minutes
h1: How to fix a flat tyre
description: Step by step guide to patching or replacing an inner tube.
text: Remove the wheel, lever off the tyre, find the puncture, patch or swap the tube and refit. Check the inside of the tyre for the cause.

title: Bike repair pricing
description: Fixed prices for the most common repairs.
text: A basic service costs a fixed amount. Parts are charged at shop price. The cost of a repair is quoted before we start.

title: Brake pad replacement guide
description: How to tell when pads are worn and how to swap them.
text: Look at the wear line on the pad. If the groove has gone, replace both pads on that wheel. Adjust the caliper after fitting.

title: Choosing a commuter bike
description: What to look for in a bike for daily travel.
text: The best commuter bike is the one you will actually ride in rain. Look for mudguards, a chain guard and a rack. Weight matters less than reliability.

title: About the Acme workshop
text: We keep a small bike storage room for customers who leave bikes over a long weekend. The workshop is open on weekdays.

title: Contact Acme
text: Email us or call during opening hours.
